created_prompt: Julie is a cooking content creator with 1.2 million followers who are interested in quick, healthy recipes. She wants to grow her online presence over the next three years and eventually publish a cookbook, but she is undecided about whether to pursue traditional oral publishing or self-publishing. She works only four days per week and has limited time and budget. Create a detailed three-year action plan with specific goals, priorities, timelines, and low-cost strategies for audience growth, content creation, brand partnerships, income opportunities, and cookbook development. Compare traditional sand self-publishing, recommend the best path based on her situation, and explain why. Make the plan realistic, practical, and achievable given her time and budget constraints.
